method: Sol v6c worker visually inspected all 76 final normalized seated views on dark 2x ten-pixel grids. South estimates hidden pelvic support from the thigh junction and lateral hip contours; east/west/north follow the underside of the pelvis. Skirt contacts estimate support beneath the pelvis, not the lowest hanging hem. Neither cane nor hearing aid determines seat support. Coordinates are individually authored, source-bound worker estimates pending manager acceptance, not inferred percentages.
